snippet.title: Skatehouse - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
My little brother (another Mister Morris) is releasing his first game, Skatehouse, a bite-sized skate shop simulator.

Releasing on August 11th, wishlist on Steam to get notified when it releases: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3153020/Skatehouse/

I’m super proud of him, he’s done a great job, and I’m excited to see what other people think 🧡
